name: AeroDisk
description: AeroDisk is a fast and efficient disk usage analyzer for macOS, Windows, and Linux
author: Sadid <sadidhasan56@gmail.com>

scripts.postinstall: node -e "if(process.platform==='darwin'){const cp=require('child_process');try{cp.execSync('codesign --force --deep --sign - node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app');console.log('Successfully ad-hoc signed Electron.app');}catch(e){console.warn('Failed to sign Electron.app:',e.message);}}"
scripts.dist:linux: yarn build && electron-builder --linux deb rpm AppImage
scripts.dist:unix: yarn build && electron-builder --mac dmg --linux deb rpm AppImage
